title: "Visual2"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Task - 3a
# =========================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CALCULATE YEARLY AVERAGES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

yearly_avg <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(pollutants),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CONVERT TO LONG FORMAT
# ---------------------------------------------------------

yearly_long <- yearly_avg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = "pollutant",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. COMPUTE RELATIVE CHANGE
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Base year = 2001

relative_df <- yearly_long %>%
  
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  
  mutate(
    base_value = value[year == 2001][1],

    relative_change = (value / base_value) * 100
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. REMOVE INVALID VALUES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

relative_df <- relative_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(relative_change),
    !is.nan(relative_change),
    is.finite(relative_change)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CREATE DIVERGENT-STYLE PLOT
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_relative <- ggplot(
  relative_df,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = relative_change,
    color = pollutant,
    group = pollutant,
    text = paste(
      "Year:", year,
      "<br>Pollutant:", pollutant,
      "<br>Relative:", round(relative_change, 1), "%"
    )
  )
) +

  # baseline
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 100,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2001, 2018, 1)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Relative Change in Pollutant Concentration (2001 = 100%)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Relative Concentration (%)",
    color = "Pollutant"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),

    legend.position = "right",

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. INTERACTIVE VERSION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ggplotly(
  p_relative,
  tooltip = "text"
)
```
